hero.title: Empowering Developers. Connecting Communities.
hero.description: Empowering developers with open-source frameworks, modern software, and developer tools, while connecting communities through intuitive Discord bots and platforms. Xernerx Studios is a unified ecosystem built for developers and communities. We combine scalable cloud infrastructure with modular libraries and an open JSON REST API so teams can build and grow faster.

about.title: About Xernerx
about.description: Founded in 2024, Xernerx Studios evolved from a focused development initiative into a modern software ecosystem of Discord bots, developer tools, and infrastructure frameworks. Every system is built with scalability, maintainability, and architectural clarity as first principles.
about.description2: Our platform unifies consumer applications and developer tooling under a single cohesive network. From multipurpose server management with Virtue and upcoming integrations for Metamorphosis and Zodiac to open-source packages and a language-agnostic JSON REST API, we engineer reliable software that scales alongside your community.

communities.title: Community Platforms & Bots
communities.description: Configure Virtue server modules, manage multi-server organizations, and explore our growing suite of Discord bots including Metamorphosis, Zodiac, and To-Do List Bot. Our tools help server owners automate moderation, boost member engagement, and track community growth in real time.

frameworks.title: Open-Source Packages & Tooling
frameworks.description: Build applications faster with our modular NPM packages and developer libraries. Every package ships with clear class references, practical examples, and versioned documentation so developers can integrate with confidence.

infrastructure.title: Open JSON REST API
infrastructure.description: Connect any bot or application in any programming language using standard HTTP JSON requests and responses. As long as your scoped Bearer token grants access, you can synchronize bot telemetry, command registries, and public profile metadata from any stack.

identity.title: One Account Everywhere
identity.description: Sign in once with Discord to unify your identity across every Xernerx web application, desktop client, and bot service. Your language preferences, custom themes, and account settings stay automatically synchronized wherever you interact with Xernerx.

consumer.title: Consumer Services
consumer.description: Powerful, user-friendly applications and platforms designed to bring communities together and streamline digital experiences. Explore our web dashboard and Discord bots built for server management, productivity, localization, and community engagement.

developer.title: Developer Software
developer.description: Robust, open-source frameworks and libraries built to empower developers to create their own incredible tools. Integrate our public REST API and modular NPM packages into your workflow.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Manage applications, configure Virtue server deployments, and monitor real-time bot telemetry from a unified web control center. Collaborate with organization members and customize server modules effortlessly.

framework.title: Xernerx Framework
framework.desc: A modular foundation for scalable Discord applications.

history.title: Our History
history.description: A structured progression from experimentation to stable infrastructure engineering.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Xernerx Studios ("we", "our", "us") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use our services.

account.title: General Account Information:
account.desc: Email, username, and profile identifiers when you register.

usage.title: Usage Data:
usage.desc: Error logs and system interactions to maintain platform stability.

integration.title: Integration Data:
integration.desc: Data provided through third-party platforms such as Discord, and payment processing details via Stripe.

developers.title: For API & Bot Developers:
developers.desc: API tokens, webhook URLs, application metadata, and configuration settings used to operate your integrations on our infrastructure.

botUsers.title: For Bot End Users:
botUsers.desc: When you interact with a bot powered by Xernerx (e.g. Zodiac, To-Do list), we process your Discord ID, server IDs, and command inputs to execute the requested actions. We do not store raw message logs unless explicitly required by an opt-in bot feature.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.content: We process personal data based on contractual necessity, legitimate interests, legal obligations, or user consent where applicable.

usage.title: 4. How We Use Information
items: To provide support, communicate platform updates, and send important service-related emails (e.g., billing, security alerts). You may manage your notification preferences or opt-out of non-essential emails at any time.
To ensure compliance with legal obligations.

sharing.title: 5. Data Sharing
items: Payment processors (e.g. Stripe) for billing and subscription management.
Legal authorities when required by law.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.content: We retain data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Policy, unless longer retention is required by law.

security.title: 7. Data Security
security.content: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect data. However, no system is absolutely secure.

rights.title: 8. Your Rights
items: Right to restrict or object to processing.
rights.content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal data. You may also object to or restrict certain processing activities, or request data portability by contacting us.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies & Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies or similar technologies to improve service performance, store interface preferences, and serve advertisements. This includes third-party services like Google AdSense, which may use cookies to serve personalized ads based on your prior visits to our platform or other websites.

international.title: 10. International Transfers
international.content: If data is transferred outside your jurisdiction, appropriate safeguards are implemented to ensure legal compliance.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Continued use of services indicates acceptance of the revised version.

apiData.title: API Data Collection & Developer Obligations
apiData.content: When developers use our REST API to synchronize bot statistics or fetch metadata, we collect and store this data to render bot pages and provide analytics. Developers are strictly prohibited from transmitting personally identifiable information (PII) of their users to our API unless explicitly requested by an endpoint. We do not sell or share API data with third-party advertisers.

childrensPrivacy.title: 11. Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.content: Our services are not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: This Cookie Policy explains how Xernerx Studios ("we", "our", or "us") uses cookies, local storage, and similar technologies when you visit or interact with our websites, dashboards, APIs, and services.

whatAreCookies.title: 2. What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your web browser when you visit a website. They allow the platform to recognize your device, maintain your authenticated session across subdomains (such as *.xernerx.com), and remember your interface preferences.

essential.title: Essential Cookies:
essential.desc: Strictly necessary for the operation and security of our services. These include authentication sessions, CSRF protection, and OAuth state verification. Because the platform cannot function securely without them, they cannot be disabled.

functional.title: Functional Cookies:
functional.desc: Used to remember your personal preferences, such as your selected language, interface theme (dark, light, or system), accent color, layout density, UI zoom, and typography scale.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies:
analytics.desc: Help us understand how visitors interact with our websites, monitor platform performance, and diagnose technical errors so we can improve reliability.

marketing.title: Marketing & Advertising Cookies:
marketing.desc: Used by third-party advertising partners (such as Google AdSense) to deliver relevant advertisements and measure campaign effectiveness.

cookiesUsed.title: 4. Specific Cookies We Set
cookiesUsed.content: Across the Xernerx ecosystem (.xernerx.com), we set and read the following first-party cookies:

auth.title: Authentication (__Secure-next-auth.session-token, __Secure-next-auth.csrf-token, __Secure-next-auth.callback-url, __Secure-next-auth.state):
auth.desc: Essential HTTP-only secure cookies managed by NextAuth to authenticate your Discord session, prevent cross-site request forgery, and handle login redirects.

consent.title: Cookie Consent (xernerx-cookie-consent):
consent.desc: An essential cookie that stores your chosen privacy and cookie preferences for up to 1 year so you are not prompted on every visit.

locale.title: Localization (NEXT_LOCALE):
locale.desc: A functional cookie that remembers your preferred interface language across all Xernerx subdomains for up to 1 year.

appearance.title: Interface & Appearance (theme, accent, uiZoom, uiGap, textScale, clientSync, syncFromDiscord):
appearance.desc: Functional cookies that preserve your visual customizations and allow the server to render your chosen theme and layout immediately without visual flickering.

localStorage.title: 5. Local Storage & Similar Technologies
localStorage.content: In addition to cookies, we utilize browser localStorage to cache non-sensitive interface settings (such as theme and layout preferences) locally on your device for instant application startup. If you use the Xernerx Desktop client (Electron), essential and functional preferences are automatically enabled to support the native application environment.

thirdParty.title: 6. Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.content: Some features and pages integrate with third-party services, including Discord (for OAuth2 authentication), Stripe (for secure checkout and billing), and Google AdSense (for displaying advertisements). These third parties may set their own cookies in accordance with their respective privacy policies.

managing.title: 7. Managing Your Preferences
managing.content: You can review or update your cookie consent choices at any time by clicking "Cookie Preferences" in the website footer. You may also configure your web browser to block or delete cookies, though blocking essential cookies will prevent you from signing in or using authenticated features.

changes.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our technology, infrastructure, or legal requirements. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.title: 9. Contact
contact.prefix: For questions regarding our use of cookies, contact

timeline.description: From early experimentation with bots to stable infrastructure engineering, see how Xernerx Studios evolved over the years into a unified platform for developers and communities.

0.title: Amethyst Development Founded
0.description: Thomas, Johannes, and Asher established Amethyst Development with a focus on scalable Discord tooling. The team set out to build reliable community utilities and modular bot foundations.

1.title: Rebranded to Portal Development
1.description: Following structural changes, the company was reintroduced under the name Portal Development. This milestone unified our early Discord projects under a shared engineering roadmap.

2.title: First Bot Acquisition
2.description: Roblox Utilities joined the portfolio, expanding our reach into multi-server utility tooling. The integration brought thousands of active community servers onto our core infrastructure.

3.title: To-Do List Bot Launched
3.description: Clari began development of To-Do List Bot, introducing structured productivity features for Discord servers. Communities gained personal task lists, shared channel boards, and automated reminders.

4.title: Discord-Translate Begins
4.description: Thomas initiated development of Discord-Translate, focused on connecting multilingual communities. The project enabled seamless cross-language conversations inside international Discord guilds.

5.title: Acquired DragDev Studios
5.description: DragDev Studios and YourApps joined the company, along with three new developers. Their expertise accelerated our work on web dashboards and custom server application workflows.

6.title: Metamorphosis Rewrite
6.description: Discord-Translate was rebuilt from the ground up and relaunched as Metamorphosis with improved infrastructure. The rewrite introduced faster translation pipelines and automated role routing.

7.title: Leadership Transition
7.description: Johannes stepped down from daily operations. Infrastructure responsibilities and backend architecture were restructured internally to prepare for long-term platform scalability.

8.title: Zodiac Development
8.description: Max began development of Zodiac, expanding our catalog into astrology and personality tooling. Social communities quickly adopted Zodiac for daily horoscopes and interactive birth chart insights.

9.title: Xernerx Studios Rebrand
9.description: The company rebranded to Xernerx Studios, reflecting a major evolution in focus and identity. We launched the unified Xernerx Suite monorepo, open JSON REST API, and open-source developer packages.

10.title: Today
10.description: You're all caught up! Today Xernerx Studios continues to ship modern software, Discord bots like Virtue, Metamorphosis, and Zodiac, and open-source developer tools for communities worldwide.

card.title: What are environments?
card.description: Within Xernerx Studios we speak of 3 environments: release (production), canary (beta) and dev (development). Here is what each of them mean:

release.label: Release
release.description: The stable production environment used for general release.

canary.label: Canary
canary.description: The beta environment used for pre-release testing of new features.

dev.label: Dev
dev.description: The development environment used for active building and testing.

card1.title: How do I become a translator?
card1.p1: You can apply directly from the Language preferences page if a language has less than 100% coverage.
card1.p2: Make sure you are logged in and on the account page.

card2.title: How long does it take for an application to be reviewed?
card2.description: Whenever an admin has time to review your submission and merge the translations with the live environment

card3.title: I translated but it didn't update?
card3.description: Translations cannot be automatically applied, the web page needs to be rebuild. Whenever you submit a review we get a notification asking to apply the newly added translations, we will allow this once reviewed.

card4.title: My language is not included in the list, how can I add it?
card4.description: For now you are required to request the language in our support channels, a language base will be created and then you can start translating for us!

card.title: How is the Estimated Value calculated?
card.description1: The Estimated Value metric displayed on bot profiles is a purely statistical estimation of a bot's "Audience & Reach Value". It is explicitly designed to gamify audience reach and measure the scale of a bot's attention economy.
card.disclaimer: ⚠️ Disclaimer: This valuation does NOT track, represent, or account for any actual financial income, subscription revenue, or server hosting expenses on the developer's end.
card.description2: The formula combines a static baseline and a dynamic growth velocity multiplier:
card.baseline: Baseline: Calculated by assigning a flat baseline weight to current active servers and users.
card.multiplier: Momentum Multiplier: We compare current baseline metrics against the bot's baseline 30 days prior. Rapidly growing bots receive a premium multiplier (up to 3.0x), while bots actively bleeding users receive a penalty discount.

hero.title: WebSocket Gateway
hero.description: High-performance RPC-over-WebSocket daemon mediating real-time database operations and cross-service coordination for Xernerx bots and applications.
hero.alertDescription: All WebSocket connections start in an unauthenticated state and must immediately authenticate with a valid token. In addition, the token needs websocket allowance. Tokens without this allowance will be rejected with a Forbidden: Token needs websocket allowance error.

overview.title: Overview & Architecture
overview.description1: The Xernerx WebSocket Gateway operates as a private, authenticated RPC microservice daemon. Rather than exposing direct database ports or requiring external bot runtimes and dashboard instances to maintain direct MongoDB connection pools, client processes establish a persistent socket connection to execute structured queries and mutations.
overview.description2: The gateway uses a correlated Request-Response RPC pattern over JSON payloads. Every client message provides an arbitrary request identifier (id), which the gateway mirrors in its response payload to allow multiplexed asynchronous communication over a single connection.

socket.title: Persistent TCP Socket
socket.desc: Avoids connection establishment overhead and retains persistent channel telemetry with IP logging.

auth.title: Token & JWT Auth
auth.desc: Secured via signed JWT tokens or shared system secrets evaluated with the jose library.

proxy.title: Isolated Database Proxy
proxy.desc: Mediates CRUD access to Mongoose models (Guilds, Users, Members) without leaking database credentials.

connecting.title: Connecting & Endpoints
connecting.description: Clients connect to the gateway using any standard WebSocket implementation (e.g., native browser WebSocket, Node.js ws).
connecting.healthChecksDesc: The WebSocket daemon also runs an embedded HTTP server on the same port for uptime monitoring and health checks:

auth.title: Authentication Handshake
auth.description: Immediately after establishing the connection, the client must authenticate. The server inspects the auth service message, validates the token against WS_TOKEN, and marks the socket session as authenticated.
auth.requestPayloadDesc: Pass your token in the body.token field. The token is checked against the database Token schema. To use the WebSocket, the token must be in an active state and have websocket allowance enabled.

protocol.title: RPC Protocol Specification
protocol.description: All operational commands sent to the gateway must adhere to the standard RPC message schema.

fields.idDesc: Arbitrary correlation ID. Mirrored directly in the response.
fields.bodyDesc: Query criteria, document filters, or payload for mutations.

methods.postDesc: Creates a new document; falls back to existing if duplicate key (11000).
methods.patchDesc: Performs atomic $set update and returns updated document.

services.title: Available Services & Actions
services.description: Services represent backend domains dynamically loaded from the server's app directory.

virtue.description: Manages leveling configurations and user activity tracking. Self-saved Virtue leveling data is stored in the isolated virtue database (separating text and voice levels per guild), while global user identity and combined platform levels are stored in the primary xernerx database.
virtue.guildsDesc: Guild leveling mode (easy, casual, balanced, hard, extreme), cycles, level message, and ignored/tracked roles.
virtue.textDesc: Guild member text level, text XP, and message count per server.
virtue.voiceDesc: Guild member voice level, voice XP, and time spent in voice per server.
virtue.globalLevelDesc: Global unified platform user level and XP (combined text & voice contribution).
virtue.globalUserDesc: Global Xernerx user account profile and settings.

xernerx.description: Primary platform service mediating global accounts, combined user leveling, economy credits, and ecosystem resources stored in the main xernerx database.
xernerx.usersDesc: Global user profile, appearance, preferences, and account metadata.
xernerx.levelsDesc: Unified platform user level and XP (aggregated across text and voice).
xernerx.creditsDesc: User balance, daily gift streak, and credit transaction status.
xernerx.tokensDesc: API and WebSocket developer tokens and permission states.
xernerx.guildsDesc: Platform-wide guild profiles and institutional registration.
xernerx.botsDesc: Registered bot metadata, reviews, votes, and verification state.

metamorphosis.desc: Metamorphosis bot profiles and integration hooks.

zodiac.desc: Zodiac bot configurations and star sign telemetry.
